answer: Suppose every task is solved twice by two credentials paired only after both commit a sealed cipher of their output, the pairing drawn from a comet-seeded orbit neither can predict. The ledger accepts work only when both commitments agree, so a lone operator must run two genuinely independent solvers rather than one duplicated, and any shared shortcut appears as an identical intermediate trace a lotus audit flags. A gale term re-pairs a fraction of tasks each epoch, stopping stables of pre-paired clones from amortizing honest duplication across cycles.
